description: Defines classes and interfaces for mobile debugging and observation in PyTorch, including MobileDebugInfo, MobileModuleObserver, and MobileObserverConfig.

classes.name: MobileDebugInfo
classes.description: Holds debugging information related to a mobile model, such as model name, method name, and operation index.

classes.name: MobileModuleObserver
classes.description: Interface for observing mobile module events like load and run method calls.

classes.name: MobileObserverConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for managing a MobileModuleObserver instance.

methods.name: observerConfig
methods.description: Returns a reference to the global MobileObserverConfig instance.

methods.name: setModuleObserver
methods.description: Sets the module observer in MobileObserverConfig.

methods.name: getModuleObserver
methods.description: Retrieves the current module observer from MobileObserverConfig.
